_comment: D1 dual-arm SAFETY ZONES -- the DERIVED export of the compiled playback gate. The single authored source of these numbers is the C++ header include/omakase_arm/safety_zones.h (the guard that gesture_play / loadCsv compile and run to refuse any dual-arm trajectory that would drive a link into the other arm or into the torso keep-out volume). This file mirrors every field that header authors that a validator needs (joint limits, capsule radii, kinematic chain, arm mounts, keep-out zones); it carries NO number that the header does not. The derivation is enforced in-repo by pyguard/tests/test_safety_zones_export.py, which text-parses the header and asserts this JSON equals it field by field, so the export cannot drift from the authored source. Geometry derived from the STEP assembly d1-face/d1_face.step (shoulder separation 74 mm = +/-0.037 m). Lengths in METRES, angles in DEGREES except arm_chain / arm_mounts rpy which are RADIANS (URDF fixed-axis roll-pitch-yaw). Frame: z up, y lateral (shoulders at y=+/-0.037, z=0.50), x forward. Conservative by design.
_chain_comment: Per-arm kinematic chain Base->Link1..Link7, IDENTICAL to safety_zones.h::armChain() (which is IDENTICAL to d1_dual.urdf Joint*_R|_L origins). Each entry is one joint's fixed origin transform: rpy = fixed-axis roll-pitch-yaw in RADIANS, xyz = translation in METRES. A consumer applies, per joint i, the fixed transform fromRpyXyz(rpy, xyz) then a rotation about local z by the commanded joint angle.
_mounts_comment: Arm base mount transforms in the torso/dual_base frame, IDENTICAL to safety_zones.h::mountA() / mountB(). A = SDK ArmSide A (Genesis _R tree, physical LEFT, +y); B = SDK ArmSide B (_L tree, physical RIGHT, -y). rpy in RADIANS, xyz in METRES. shoulder_half_width_m / shoulder_z_m above are the |xyz.y| / xyz.z of these mounts, kept as scalar conveniences.
